topic: Open research output of the Berkeley Alt: Meat Lab
claim_a: The lab said in 2017 that it would develop research and open up the industry by freely distributing findings, and in 2019 that a new grant would let students and researchers share their discoveries (AML-03; AML-04).
claim_b: We found one closed-access 2021 book chapter by lab-affiliated authors on alternative protein, and no open data, methods or reports, 2017 to 2026; the director's recent papers are on Quillaja saponins (AML-24; AML-25).
position_taken: Follow the retrieved record: the lab's value is teaching and venture building, not citable research. Do not cite it as a source of technical results.
notes: Absence in OpenAlex and on the lab site does not prove that nothing exists; partner projects may have produced confidential reports.
